ja: 都合が悪いのは週末全部じゃなくて、日曜の朝だけなんだ。
en: It's only Sunday morning that doesn't work for me, not the whole weekend.
alternatives: What doesn't work for me is just Sunday morning, not the whole weekend.
It's just Sunday morning that's bad for me, not the whole weekend.
point: 強調したい「日曜の朝」を It's と that で挟む

ja: ごめん、疲れてるからパーティーに行けないよ。
en: Sorry, I can't go to the party. I'm tired.
alternatives: Sorry, I'm too tired to go to the party.
Sorry, I can't come to the party. I'm tired.
point: 「行けない」は can't go、理由は短く別の文で足せる

ja: 幹事に頼んで、来週の同窓会の開始を一時間遅らせてもらったよ。
en: I got the organizer to push the start of next week's reunion back an hour.
alternatives: I had the organizer push back the start of next week's reunion by an hour.
I asked the organizer to move next week's reunion an hour later, and they did.
point: get 人 to do と have 人 do、to の有無に注意

ja: キャンセルするなら、せめて前の日に教えてくれればよかったのに。
en: If you were going to cancel, you should have at least told me the day before.
alternatives: You could have at least let me know the day before if you were going to cancel.
If you had to cancel, you should have at least told me a day earlier.
point: 「〜すればよかったのに」は should have + 過去分詞
